title: Siege of Khartoum
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Khartoum", at revision 1379636555, opens: "The siege of Khartoum took place from 13 March 1884 to 26 January 1885. Sudanese Mahdist forces captured the city of Khartoum, Sudan, from its Egyptian garrison, thereby gaining control over the whole of Turco-Egyptian Sudan." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q815159, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1885 offensive by Mahdist Forces against British and Egyptian troops". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
